blocks.text: Kelajakdagi bir nuqtaga qarab: davom etayotgan yoki tugagan?

Bu darsdagi ikkala zamon ham kelajakdagi aniq bir **nuqtani** tayanch qilib oladi: «ertaga soat o'nda», «kelasi yil shu paytda», «2030-yilga kelib». Savol bitta: o'sha paytda harakat **davom etayotgan** bo'ladimi yoki allaqachon **tugagan** bo'ladimi? O'zbekcha bu farqni juda aniq beradi: «-ayotgan bo'laman» va «-gan bo'laman». Bu juftlik Past Continuous (→ 6-dars) va Past Perfect (→ 15-dars) ning kelajakdagi «aksi»: o'sha qoidalar, faqat nuqta kelajakda.

rows: imtihon soat 8 dan beri davom etyapti
I**'ll have been taking** it for two hours.

blocks.text: Future Continuous (kelasi davomli zamon) — **will be + -ing**. Asosiy ma'nosi: kelajakdagi ma'lum paytda biz harakatning **o'rtasida** bo'lamiz — u o'sha paytdan oldin boshlangan va keyin ham davom etadi. Ko'pincha **this time tomorrow**, **at ten o'clock**, **when you arrive**, **all evening** kabi vaqt ifodalari bilan keladi. Holat fe'llari (know, want, belong) bu zamonda ishlatilmaydi (→ 4-dars). Quyidagi jadvalda darsning uchala shakli:

items.text: At ten tomorrow **I'll be sitting** an exam, so I can't answer the phone.
items.translation: Ertaga soat o'nda imtihon **topshirayotgan bo'laman**, telefonni ko'tara olmayman.

items.text: Don't visit them on Sunday — they**'ll be moving** house.
items.translation: Yakshanba kuni ularnikiga borma — uy **ko'chirayotgan bo'lishadi**.

items.text: This time next week **we'll be skiing** in the mountains.
items.translation: Kelasi hafta shu paytda tog'larda **chang'i uchayotgan bo'lamiz**.

blocks.text: Odatdagidek bo'ladigan ish: I'll be passing ... anyway

Future Continuous ning ikkinchi, nozik ma'nosi: harakat **baribir** — odatdagi tartib yoki tayyor reja bo'yicha bo'ladi; bu yangi qaror ham, va'da ham emas. I**'ll be seeing** Tom tomorrow — Ertaga Tom bilan baribir ko'rishaman (ishda, darsda). Shuning uchun bu shakl yordam taklif qilishda qulay: «u yerdan baribir o'taman, sizga ham olib kelaman». Rasmiy e'lonlarda ham ko'p uchraydi: We**'ll be landing** shortly. O'zbekchada odatda oddiy kelasi zamon, ko'pincha «baribir» so'zi bilan.
Muloyim savol: Will you be using ...?

**Will you ...?** ko'pincha iltimos bo'lib eshitiladi (→ 23-dars). Agar odamning **rejasini** muloyim so'rash kerak bo'lsa (ko'pincha iltimosdan oldin), **Will you be -ing?** ishlatiladi: u bosim qilmaydi, faqat «rejangiz qanday?» deb so'raydi. Do'konda, mehmonxonada, ishda bu juda tabiiy savol.

headers: Will you be -ing? — reja haqida savol
rows: **Will** you **lend** me your car? (Mashinangni berib tur.)
**Will** you **be using** your car tonight? (Bugun mashinadan foydalanasanmi?)
**Will** you **be coming** to the party? (Kelasanmi, rejang qanday?)

items.text: I**'ll be going** past the pharmacy — do you need anything?
items.translation: Dorixona yonidan baribir **o'taman** — biror narsa kerakmi?

items.text: **Will** you **be using** the printer this afternoon?

blocks.text: Future Perfect (kelasi tugallangan zamon) — **will have + V3**: harakat kelajakdagi nuqtagacha **tugagan** bo'ladi. O'zbekcha «-gan bo'laman», «-ib bo'lgan bo'laman». Deyarli doim **by** bilan keladi: **by Friday** — «jumagacha» (juma kuni yoki undan oldin), **by then** — «u paytgacha», **by the time** + Present Simple — «...guncha» (by the time you **arrive**, «you will arrive» emas → 25-dars). Ehtiyot bo'ling: **by** — muddat (eng kechi shu payt), **until** — davomiylik (shu paytgacha to'xtovsiz): I'll finish it **by** Friday, lekin I'll be here **until** Friday.

items.text: The meeting starts at nine, and I**'ll have prepared** everything by eight.
items.translation: Yig'ilish soat to'qqizda boshlanadi, men soat sakkizgacha hammasini **tayyorlab qo'ygan bo'laman**.

items.text: By the end of the year Aziz **will have paid** back all his debts.
items.translation: Yil oxiriga kelib Aziz barcha qarzlarini **to'lab bo'lgan bo'ladi**.

items.text: Hurry up, or the shops **will have closed**!

blocks.text: **will have + V3** ba'zan hozirgi paytdagi ishonchli taxmin uchun ham ishlatiladi: It's ten o'clock — they**'ll have arrived** by now. — Soat o'n bo'ldi, ular hozirgacha **yetib kelgan bo'lishsa kerak**. Bu ma'noda u **must have done** ga yaqin (→ 28-dars).
Future Perfect Continuous: will have been -ing

Kelajakdagi nuqtada harakat **qancha vaqtdan beri** davom etayotgan bo'lishini aytish uchun — **will have been + -ing** (odatda **for** bilan). Bu Present Perfect Continuous (→ 9-dars) ning kelajakdagi ko'rinishi. O'zbekchada eng tabiiy tarjima — «...ganiga ... bo'ladi / to'ladi»: Next year I**'ll have been living** here for ten years — Kelasi yil bu yerda **yashayotganimga** o'n yil **to'ladi**. Kundalik nutqda kamroq uchraydi, lekin yubiley, ish staji, uzoq safar haqida gapirganda juda qulay.

O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «I'll finish it until Friday» → **by** Friday (until — davomiylik uchun); «By the time you will come...» → by the time you **come**; «I will be work at ten» → I'll be **working** (-ing tushib qoladi); «I'll have finish» → I'll have **finished** (V3 kerak); «Tomorrow I'll be knowing the results» → I**'ll know** (holat fe'li continuous bo'lmaydi); «-gan bo'laman» ni so'zma-so'z «I will be ...ed» deb tarjima qilish → **will have + V3**.

Vaqt chizig'ini chizing va kelajakdagi nuqtani belgilang. Harakat shu nuqtani «kesib o'tsa» — will be -ing; nuqtadan oldin tugasa — will have + V3; nuqtagacha qancha davom etgani muhim bo'lsa — will have been -ing. Gapda **by** bo'lsa — deyarli doim Future Perfect.

rows: I**'ll have been working** here for a year.

examples.title: At a future moment: **will be doing**
examples.description: Kelajakdagi ma'lum paytda harakat davom etayotgan bo'ladi — o'zbekcha «-ayotgan bo'laman».

sentences.text: This time tomorrow **I'll be lying** on a beach in Antalya.
sentences.translation: Ertaga shu paytda Antalyada sohilda **yotgan bo'laman**.

sentences.text: Don't call Madina at nine — she**'ll be putting** the kids to bed.
sentences.translation: Madinaga soat to'qqizda qo'ng'iroq qilma — bolalarni **uxlatayotgan bo'ladi**.

sentences.text: At eleven o'clock on Monday, Aziz **will be taking** his driving test.
sentences.translation: Dushanba kuni soat o'n birda Aziz haydovchilik imtihonini **topshirayotgan bo'ladi**.

sentences.text: When you land in London, we**'ll be waiting** for you at the arrivals gate.
sentences.translation: Londonga qo'nganingizda, sizni kelish zalida **kutib turgan bo'lamiz**.

sentences.text: Next week at this time the whole team **will be working** on the new project.
sentences.translation: Kelasi hafta shu paytda butun jamoa yangi loyiha ustida **ishlayotgan bo'ladi**.

sentences.text: Try not to phone after midnight, because I**'ll be sleeping**.
sentences.translation: Yarim tundan keyin qo'ng'iroq qilmaslikka harakat qil, chunki **uxlayotgan bo'laman**.

sentences.text: In ten years' time, Jasur **will** probably **be running** his own company.
sentences.translation: O'n yildan keyin Jasur, ehtimol, o'z kompaniyasini **boshqarayotgan bo'ladi**.

sentences.text: **Will** you **be wearing** a suit at the interview, or something more casual?
sentences.translation: Suhbatda kostyumda **bo'lasanmi** yoki oddiyroq kiyimdami?

sentences.text: At seven the guests **will be arriving**, so the food must be ready before then.
sentences.translation: Soat yettida mehmonlar **kelayotgan bo'ladi**, shuning uchun ovqat undan oldin tayyor bo'lishi kerak.

sentences.text: Sarah **won't be working** on Friday afternoon, so she can meet you then.
sentences.translation: Sara juma kuni tushdan keyin **ishda bo'lmaydi**, shuning uchun siz bilan o'shanda uchrasha oladi.

examples.title: As usual, anyway: **I'll be passing** ...
examples.description: Harakat odatdagi tartib yoki tayyor reja bo'yicha baribir bo'ladi — yangi qaror emas. Rasmiy e'lonlarda ham shu shakl.

sentences.text: I**'ll be passing** the post office anyway, so I can send your parcel.
sentences.translation: Baribir pochta yonidan **o'taman**, posilkangizni jo'natib qo'yaman.

sentences.text: I**'ll be seeing** Kate at the meeting tomorrow — shall I give her your message?
sentences.translation: Ertaga yig'ilishda Keyt bilan baribir **ko'rishaman** — xabaringizni yetkazaymi?

sentences.text: Don't book a taxi; Bekzod **will be driving** to the airport too, and he can take you.
sentences.translation: Taksi chaqirma; Bekzod ham aeroportga mashinada **boradi**, seni olib ketadi.

sentences.text: The President **will be meeting** business leaders during his visit to Fergana.
sentences.translation: Prezident Farg'onaga tashrifi chog'ida tadbirkorlar bilan **uchrashadi**.

sentences.text: We**'ll be having** dinner at about eight, so why don't you join us?
sentences.translation: Taxminan soat sakkizda kechki ovqat **qilamiz**, nega bizga qo'shilmaysiz?

sentences.text: Mr Brown **will be leaving** the company at the end of the month, after thirty years.
sentences.translation: Janob Braun o'ttiz yillik ishdan so'ng oy oxirida kompaniyadan **ketadi**.

sentences.text: Ladies and gentlemen, we**'ll be landing** in Edinburgh in about twenty minutes.
sentences.translation: Xonimlar va janoblar, taxminan yigirma daqiqadan keyin Edinburgga **qo'namiz**.

sentences.text: From next Monday the supermarket **will be opening** an hour earlier than usual.
sentences.translation: Kelasi dushanbadan supermarket odatdagidan bir soat erta **ochiladi**.

sentences.text: Nilufar **will be travelling** around Europe all summer, so she won't need her car.
sentences.translation: Nilufar butun yoz Yevropa bo'ylab **sayohat qiladi**, shuning uchun mashinasi kerak bo'lmaydi.

sentences.text: Since you**'ll be going** to the bazaar anyway, could you buy some fresh herbs?
sentences.translation: Baribir bozorga **borasan**, ozgina ko'kat olib kelolmaysanmi?

examples.title: Polite questions: **Will you be using** ...?
examples.description: Odamning rejasi haqida muloyim savol — Will you be -ing? U iltimos emas, shuning uchun bosim qilmaydi.

sentences.text: **Will** you **be using** your laptop this evening? Mine has stopped working.
sentences.translation: Bugun kechqurun noutbukingdan **foydalanasanmi**? Meniki ishlamay qoldi.

sentences.text: **Will** you **be needing** the car tomorrow, or can I borrow it?
sentences.translation: Ertaga mashina senga **kerak bo'ladimi** yoki olib tursam bo'ladimi?

sentences.text: **Will** Tom **be coming** to the meeting, or should we start without him?
sentences.translation: Tom yig'ilishga **keladimi** yoki usiz boshlayveraylikmi?

sentences.text: How long **will** you **be staying** in Tashkent? — Just a week, unfortunately.
sentences.translation: Toshkentda qancha vaqt **qolasiz**? — Afsuski, faqat bir hafta.

sentences.text: What time **will** your parents **be arriving**? I'd like to meet them at the station.
sentences.translation: Ota-onangiz soat nechada **yetib keladi**? Ularni vokzalda kutib olmoqchiman.

sentences.text: Which hotel **will** the delegation **be staying** at during the conference?
sentences.translation: Konferensiya davomida delegatsiya qaysi mehmonxonada **turadi**?

sentences.text: Excuse me, **will** you **be paying** by card or in cash?
sentences.translation: Kechirasiz, karta bilan **to'laysizmi** yoki naqd pulda?

sentences.text: Is Madina free tonight? — No, she**'ll be studying** for her exam all evening.
sentences.translation: Madina bugun kechqurun bo'shmi? — Yo'q, kechqurun bo'yi imtihonga **tayyorlanayotgan bo'ladi**.

sentences.text: When **will** you **be going** to the shops? Could you get me some batteries?
sentences.translation: Do'konga qachon **borasan**? Menga batareya olib kelolmaysanmi?

sentences.text: Where **will** you **be living** after you graduate — here or in Oxford?
sentences.translation: O'qishni bitirgandan keyin qayerda **yashaysan** — shu yerdami yoki Oksfordda?

examples.title: Finished before a future time: **will have done**
examples.description: Harakat kelajakdagi nuqtagacha tugagan bo'ladi — «-gan bo'laman». Ko'pincha by Friday, by then, by the time bilan.

sentences.text: Don't worry, I**'ll have finished** the report by Friday.
sentences.translation: Xavotir olmang, hisobotni juma kunigacha **tugatgan bo'laman**.

sentences.text: By the time we get to the cinema, the film **will have started**.
sentences.translation: Kinoteatrga yetib borgunimizcha film **boshlanib bo'lgan bo'ladi**.

sentences.text: Call me after ten — the children **will have gone** to bed by then.
sentences.translation: Soat o'ndan keyin qo'ng'iroq qil — u paytgacha bolalar **uxlagani yotgan bo'ladi**.

sentences.text: By 2030 the city **will have built** three new metro lines.
sentences.translation: 2030-yilga kelib shahar uchta yangi metro liniyasini **qurib bo'lgan bo'ladi**.

sentences.text: By next June Madina **will have graduated** from university and started work.
sentences.translation: Kelasi iyungacha Madina universitetni **bitirib**, ishga **kirgan bo'ladi**.

sentences.text: We**'ll have saved** enough money for a flat within two years, if everything goes well.
sentences.translation: Hammasi yaxshi bo'lsa, ikki yil ichida kvartiraga yetarli pul **yig'ib bo'lgan bo'lamiz**.

sentences.text: **Will** you **have finished** with the computer before lunch? I need to print something.
sentences.translation: Tushlikkacha kompyuter bilan ishingni **tugatgan bo'lasanmi**? Bir narsa chop etishim kerak.

sentences.text: The workers **won't have repaired** the road before the winter, I'm afraid.
sentences.translation: Afsuski, ishchilar qishgacha yo'lni **ta'mirlab ulgurmagan bo'ladi**.

sentences.text: Sarah is a fast reader, so she**'ll have read** the whole book by the weekend.
sentences.translation: Sara tez o'qiydi, shuning uchun hafta oxirigacha butun kitobni **o'qib bo'lgan bo'ladi**.

sentences.text: When Grandpa retires next year, he**'ll have taught** more than five thousand students.
sentences.translation: Bobom kelasi yil nafaqaga chiqqanida, besh mingdan ortiq o'quvchiga **dars bergan bo'ladi**.

examples.title: How long by then? **will have been doing**
examples.description: Kelajakdagi nuqtada harakat qancha vaqtdan beri davom etayotgan bo'ladi. O'zbekchada ko'pincha «...ganiga ... bo'ladi / to'ladi».

sentences.text: Next month I**'ll have been working** here for exactly ten years.
sentences.translation: Kelasi oy bu yerda **ishlaganimga** roppa-rosa o'n yil **bo'ladi**.

sentences.text: By the time the plane lands, we**'ll have been flying** for nine hours.
sentences.translation: Samolyot qo'nganida biz to'qqiz soatdan beri **uchayotgan bo'lamiz**.

sentences.text: In September Dilnoza **will have been studying** English for five years.
sentences.translation: Sentyabrda Dilnoza ingliz tilini **o'rganayotganiga** besh yil **bo'ladi**.

sentences.text: At six o'clock the students **will have been sitting** in the exam hall for four hours.
sentences.translation: Soat oltida talabalar imtihon zalida to'rt soatdan beri **o'tirgan bo'lishadi**.

sentences.text: Poor Tom! By the end of the day he**'ll have been driving** for twelve hours.
sentences.translation: Bechora Tom! Kun oxiriga kelib u o'n ikki soatdan beri **mashina haydayotgan bo'ladi**.

sentences.text: On our anniversary we**'ll have been living** in this flat for twenty years.
sentences.translation: Yubileyimizda bu kvartirada **yashayotganimizga** yigirma yil **to'ladi**.

sentences.text: Next week the builders **will have been working** on our street for a whole year!
sentences.translation: Kelasi hafta quruvchilar ko'chamizda **ishlayotganiga** butun bir yil **bo'ladi**!

sentences.text: When Emma finally gets her degree, she**'ll have been studying** for seven years.
sentences.translation: Emma nihoyat diplom olganida, u yetti yildan beri **o'qiyotgan bo'ladi**.

sentences.text: How long **will** you **have been teaching** when you retire?
sentences.translation: Nafaqaga chiqqaningizda necha yildan beri **dars berayotgan bo'lasiz**?

sentences.text: By midnight the protesters **will have been standing** outside the building for two days.
sentences.translation: Yarim tunga kelib namoyishchilar bino oldida ikki kundan beri **turgan bo'lishadi**.

examples.title: **will be doing** or **will have done**?
examples.description: Juft-juft taqqoslash: kelajakdagi nuqtada harakat hali davom etyapti (will be -ing) yoki allaqachon tugagan (will have + V3).

sentences.text: At eight I**'ll be having** dinner, so call me after nine.
sentences.translation: Soat sakkizda **kechki ovqat qilayotgan bo'laman**, shuning uchun to'qqizdan keyin qo'ng'iroq qil.

sentences.text: Call me at nine — I**'ll have had** dinner by then, and we can talk.
sentences.translation: Soat to'qqizda qo'ng'iroq qil — u paytgacha **ovqatlanib bo'lgan bo'laman**, gaplashamiz.

sentences.text: Tomorrow at noon James **will be flying** over the Atlantic.
sentences.translation: Ertaga tushda Jeyms Atlantika ustidan **uchib ketayotgan bo'ladi**.

sentences.text: By tomorrow evening James **will have landed** in New York.
sentences.translation: Ertaga kechqurungacha Jeyms Nyu-Yorkka **qo'ngan bo'ladi**.

sentences.text: Don't arrive at ten — the staff **will** still **be preparing** the hall.
sentences.translation: Soat o'nda kelmang — xodimlar hali zalni **tayyorlayotgan bo'lishadi**.

sentences.text: Come at eleven instead; they**'ll have prepared** everything by then.
sentences.translation: Yaxshisi, soat o'n birda keling; u paytgacha hammasini **tayyorlab qo'ygan bo'lishadi**.

sentences.text: This time next year Bekzod **will be doing** his military service.
sentences.translation: Kelasi yil shu paytda Bekzod harbiy xizmatni **o'tayotgan bo'ladi**.

sentences.text: By this time next year Bekzod **will have finished** his military service.
sentences.translation: Kelasi yil shu paytgacha Bekzod harbiy xizmatni **tugatgan bo'ladi**.

sentences.text: When you wake up, I**'ll be driving** to Bukhara.
sentences.translation: Sen uyg'onganingda men Buxoroga **ketayotgan bo'laman**.

sentences.text: By the time you wake up, I**'ll have left** for the airport.
sentences.translation: Sen uyg'onguningcha men aeroportga **jo'nab ketgan bo'laman**.

examples.title: Dialogue: planning a busy Thursday
examples.description: Ikki hamkasb payshanba kunini rejalashtiradi: kim qaysi paytda nima qilayotgan bo'ladi va nimani tugatgan bo'ladi.

sentences.text: — Sarah, **will** you **be working** from the office on Thursday?
sentences.translation: — Sara, payshanba kuni ofisda **ishlaysizmi**?

sentences.text: — Yes, but in the morning **I'll be interviewing** new candidates.
sentences.translation: — Ha, lekin ertalab yangi nomzodlar bilan **suhbat o'tkazayotgan bo'laman**.

sentences.text: — What time **will** you **have finished** with them, do you think?
sentences.translation: — Sizningcha, ular bilan soat nechagacha **ishingizni tugatgan bo'lasiz**?

sentences.text: — By twelve I**'ll have seen** all five of them, I hope.
sentences.translation: — Umid qilamanki, soat o'n ikkigacha beshalasini ham **ko'rib bo'lgan bo'laman**.

sentences.text: — Good. I**'ll be passing** your office at about one anyway.
sentences.translation: — Yaxshi. Baribir soat birlar atrofida xonangiz yonidan **o'taman**.

sentences.text: — Fine, but I**'ll be having** a quick lunch at my desk then.
sentences.translation: — Mayli, lekin o'sha payt stolimda tezgina **tushlik qilayotgan bo'laman**.

sentences.text: — No problem. By then **I'll have printed** the budget figures.
sentences.translation: — Muammo yo'q. U paytgacha byudjet raqamlarini **chop etib qo'ygan bo'laman**.

sentences.text: — Great. **Will** the director **be joining** us, or just the two of us?
sentences.translation: — Zo'r. Direktor ham bizga **qo'shiladimi** yoki faqat ikkalamizmi?

sentences.text: — Just us. He**'ll be flying** back from London on Thursday.
sentences.translation: — Faqat biz. U payshanba kuni Londondan **uchib qaytayotgan bo'ladi**.

sentences.text: — OK. Let's hope we**'ll have agreed** on everything before he lands!
sentences.translation: — Xo'p. U qo'nguncha hamma narsada **kelishib olgan bo'lishimizga** umid qilaylik!

examples.title: Mixed: careers, travel and the future
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: uchala shakl — will be -ing, will have + V3, will have been -ing — murakkabroq gaplarda.

sentences.text: In five years' time, robots **will be delivering** most parcels in big cities.
sentences.translation: Besh yildan keyin katta shaharlarda posilkalarning ko'pini robotlar **yetkazib berayotgan bo'ladi**.

sentences.text: By the end of this course, you**'ll have learnt** all the main tenses.
sentences.translation: Bu kurs oxiriga kelib barcha asosiy zamonlarni **o'rganib bo'lgan bo'lasiz**.

sentences.text: Text me rather than calling, because I**'ll be presenting** our results all afternoon.
sentences.translation: Qo'ng'iroq qilgandan ko'ra yozib yubor, chunki tushdan keyin bo'yi natijalarimizni **taqdim etayotgan bo'laman**.

sentences.text: **Will** the new bridge **have opened** by the time the tourist season begins?
sentences.translation: Turistik mavsum boshlanguncha yangi ko'prik **ochilgan bo'ladimi**?

sentences.text: Next Friday Oliver and Kate **will have been married** for exactly a year.
sentences.translation: Kelasi juma Oliver va Keyt **turmush qurganiga** roppa-rosa bir yil **bo'ladi**.

sentences.text: While you're relaxing on the beach, I**'ll be sitting** in a hot office in Tashkent.
sentences.translation: Sen sohilda dam olayotganingda men Toshkentda issiq ofisda **o'tirgan bo'laman**.

sentences.text: Our flight is at six, so we**'ll** probably **have checked in** by five.
sentences.translation: Reysimiz soat oltida, shuning uchun soat beshgacha ro'yxatdan **o'tib bo'lgan bo'lsak kerak**.

sentences.text: By the time the guests arrive, Dilnoza **will have been cooking** for six hours.
sentences.translation: Mehmonlar kelguncha Dilnoza olti soatdan beri **ovqat pishirayotgan bo'ladi**.

sentences.text: I hope the rain **will have stopped** by the time the match starts.
sentences.translation: Umid qilamanki, o'yin boshlanguncha yomg'ir **to'xtagan bo'ladi**.

sentences.text: Scientists believe that by 2050 sea levels **will have risen** by at least thirty centimetres.
sentences.translation: Olimlarning fikricha, 2050-yilga kelib dengiz sathi kamida o'ttiz santimetrga **ko'tarilgan bo'ladi**.
